description: Tests one of a project's saved connections now, by asking the service the same cheapest "does this sign-in work" question CodeGene's own checks ask; nothing is sent, written or changed at the service. Answers works: true with the account it signed in as, or works: false with the problem and, when a database could not be reached (an allow list, a private address, a closed port, a wrong address), `guide`: what happened, why, and the steps for that database's host, simplest first. Read the guide's options to the person in its own words. A guide that offers a private network can be followed with add_private_network. A sign-in the service refuses is recorded on the connection, as any use of it would be.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
